culprit_citations.quoted_text: Funded debt row has Reference SOFR(Q), Spread 4.25%, and Interest Rate 7.91%.
Undrawn row has First Lien - Undrawn with dash values in Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate.
Unfunded debt row has First Lien - Undrawn with dash values in Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate.
Total Unfunded Debt Investments section total confirms the missing-rate rows belong to the unfunded debt schedule.

findings.detail: C01 is counting unfunded/undrawn debt commitment rows whose source interest-rate cells are dashes, while funded debt rows carry rates.

rationale: C01 failed because only 63.8% of debt rows have an extracted rate, but the raw filing distinguishes funded debt rows, which show reference, spread, and interest-rate values, from unfunded/undrawn debt rows, which intentionally show dashes in those columns. The low coverage is therefore caused by the check scope counting unfunded/undrawn commitment rows as debt rows requiring rates, not by a raw-source extraction defect.
